findings.title: The post-bootstrap compatibility fixture contradicts terminal W1.A04 witness handling and leaves the focused suite red
findings.reproduction: Run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest -v tests.foundation.test_taskctl_schema tests.foundation.test_taskctl_workflow` at submitted state 079f1e9d0ccaadf571992b2229c4ebcd74f2131c. The run executes 98 tests and fails `test_wave_resume_allows_only_the_exact_required_historical_witness` because it expects tampered terminal-witness bytes to raise after the canonical backlog now records W1.A04 as SUPERSEDED. That expectation conflicts with the generic post-migration rule in `wave_resume_allowed_untracked`, which admits only the inert historical path without opening it once exact supersession authority is present. The stale test also seeds its temporary fixture by calling `read_bytes()` on the protected live repository witness, while the adjacent new test asserts that terminal admission must not open that witness.
findings.requiredRemediation: Preserve the no-read terminal-supersession implementation. Refactor the legacy test to exercise pre-supersession hash and identity rejection with fully synthetic fixture bytes, never the protected repository witness; separately prove that exact terminal W1.A04 supersession admits only the named inert path without reading it, including missing or altered bytes. Then rerun the exact focused schema/workflow/UI-reference and post-bootstrap planctl suites at the new frozen submission state.
